mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over 3 months signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% MoM signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where RSAFS declines > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases > 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 2%, the combination signals a potential stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 jobs MoM signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines > 100,000 MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and Real GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% YoY, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and GDPC1 growth < 1% YoY
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where HOUST declines > 10% YoY and GDPC1 growth < 1% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5%.
